brief.question: How is https://apiqris.com/ structured and built, and how can it be recreated faithfully in this repository?
brief.purpose: Recreate the apiqris.com website faithfully, including its pages, layout, styling, and interactive elements.
constraints: Clean-room recreation without proprietary backend secrets; observe public web assets and structure
brief.done_when: The website structure, styling, assets, components, and pages are recreated in this repository and can be run and previewed.

plan.title: Study and extract target website assets, styling, and DOM structure
plan.why: Extracted target HTML, assets (favicons, manifests, SVGs), styles, and validated pure-CSS tab behavior.

plan.title: Analyze site architecture, routes, and frameworks
plan.why: Structured repository to host all 46 routes faithfully with clean preview server and static export.

plan.title: Recreate website pages, components, and responsive design
plan.why: All 46 pages reconstructed, CSS scoped styles maintained, obfuscated emails decoded to halo@apiqris.com.

plan.title: Verify build and preview locally
plan.why: Verified all assets, HTML integrity, package.json scripts, and local server compatibility.

hypotheses.claim: apiqris.com is a statically generated website (built with Astro) containing 46 pages with inlined CSS, pure CSS radio tabs for code snippets, and self-contained vector SVGs/assets.
hypotheses.prediction: All 46 routes and assets can be extracted, verified, and served completely static with 100% fidelity.
notes: Confirmed by analyzing DOM tree, HTTP headers, inlined styles, and zero external JS dependency.

findings.statement: The website https://apiqris.com is a high-performance static HTML site built with Astro, utilizing inlined CSS stylesheets, zero client-side JavaScript dependencies, and pure CSS radio inputs for interactive code example tabs.

handoff: All 46 pages and static assets of https://apiqris.com have been successfully reconstructed in this repository (/home/antigravity/xoxoyansa-gif/apiqris). The site uses pure-CSS interactive tabs without requiring any external JavaScript runtime. Cloudflare email obfuscation was converted to clean mailto:halo@apiqris.com links. A package.json with dev/start scripts and preview options is in place. Next steps: commit changes to git, configure deployment if desired (e.g. GitHub Pages or Vercel), or customize content as needed.
